fine_trace.note: Allocates 2*num_components*DCTSIZE2 ints, but the following init loop (lines 667-670) writes -1 to only the first num_components*DCTSIZE2 entries (current-scan coef_bits). The second half -- prev_coef_bits rows for all components, including Cb and Cr -- is never initialized and holds stale heap bytes.

prev_coef_bits is refreshed only for components present in the current scan. For the two non-interleaved Y DC scans (scans 2 and 3), only cindex==0 (Y) gets prev_coef_bits written; the Cb/Cr prev_coef_bits rows are never written and remain uninitialized.

smoothing_ok() copies prev_coef_bits (uninitialized for Cb/Cr) into the prev_coef_bits_latch[] region of coef->coef_bits_latch, which was allocated with alloc_small (uninitialized). In the default single-pass flow smoothing_ok() runs at input_scan_number==1, so this branch is skipped and the whole prev_coef_bits_latch region stays uninitialized.

fine_trace.code: if (cinfo->output_iMCU_row > cinfo->master->last_good_iMCU_row) coef_bits = coef->coef_bits_latch + ((ci + cinfo->num_components) * SAVED_COEFS);
fine_trace.note: Because scan-1 entropy covered only iMCU row 0, the decoder hit the scan-2 SOS marker and cinfo->master->last_good_iMCU_row stayed 0. While smoothing the second iMCU row (output_iMCU_row==1), this condition selects the prev_coef_bits_latch region, which contains uninitialized values for Cb and Cr.

fine_trace.code: change_dc = coef_bits[1] == -1 && coef_bits[2] == -1 && coef_bits[3] == -1 && coef_bits[4] == -1 && coef_bits[5] == -1 && coef_bits[6] == -1 && coef_bits[7] == -1 && coef_bits[8] == -1 && coef_bits[9] == -1;
fine_trace.note: Branching on the uninitialized prev_coef_bits_latch values (coef_bits[1..9]) for the Cb/Cr components is the uninitialized-memory read (use-of-uninitialized-value) reported by MemorySanitizer; the same values also drive the AC-estimation branches below (e.g. 'if ((Al = coef_bits[1]) != 0 ...)' at line 608).

vuln_logic.issue_alignment: Malformed progressive JPEG with an interleaved Y/Cb/Cr DC scan followed by two non-interleaved Y DC scans: prev_coef_bits[] is initialized only for the Y component (scans 2/3), so Cb/Cr prev_coef_bits stay uninitialized; smoothing_ok() latches those uninitialized values into prev_coef_bits_latch[], and when cinfo->master->last_good_iMCU_row is 0, decompress_smooth_data() reads them while smoothing the second iMCU row.
